notes: Tapping a lyric line gives a brief highlight, then playback resumes driving the highlight and word-by-word and letter-by-letter timing.
Lyrics auto-scroll stays with the playing line, and re-timing or translating no longer jumps the sheet back to the top.
Playlist loading now checks the saved playlist row directly if the settings read misses it; browsing Albums still leaves playlists unchanged.
An older audio-timing result cannot replace lyrics after playback has moved to another song.
